categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Edadoc Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in PCB (Printed Circuit Board) design services and PCBA (PCB Assembly) manufacturing services. The company offers one-stop hardware innovation services including PCB design, prototyping, small to medium batch manufacturing, and material procurement services. Its customer base spans industries such as network communication, industrial control, integrated circuits, artificial intelligence, medical electronics, smart transportation, and aerospace.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced PCB design and simulation technologies including signal integrity (SI) and power integrity (PI) simulations, electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) analysis, and design for manufacturing (DFM) principles. It employs electronic design automation (EDA) software tools and has expertise in high-density interconnect (HDI) PCB design, high-speed communication backplane design, and packaging substrate design. Production methods include surface mount technology (SMT), dual-inline package (DIP) assembly, and flexible manufacturing systems for rapid prototyping and small batch production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading enterprises in sectors such as network communication, industrial control, integrated circuits, artificial intelligence, medical electronics, smart transportation, and aerospace. The company collaborates with global technology giants like Intel, AMD, NVIDIA, Apple, Google, and domestic chip manufacturers such as HiSilicon, Loongson, and Phytium. Its services support hardware innovation and product development in both traditional and emerging technology markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major facilities and sales offices in Shenzhen, Shanghai, Chengdu, Changsha, Zhuhai, and Tianjin. It also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in the United States. Its sales cover domestic electronic industry hubs and export markets including the United States, Japan, and Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Edadoc Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, focusing on PCB design and PCBA manufacturing. It has recently expanded upstream by investing in PCB manufacturing facilities to complement its design and assembly services, aiming to provide integrated one-stop hardware innovation solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes strengthening its PCB design team and maintaining technological leadership through continuous R&D investment. It focuses on high-end PCB design technologies, including multi-layer, high-density, high-speed, and high-reliability PCBs. R&D efforts target emerging fields such as AI, 5G, automotive electronics, medical devices, and aerospace. The company also emphasizes expanding flexible PCBA manufacturing capacity to support rapid prototyping and small to medium batch production.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of PCB design services and PCBA manufacturing services. The company operates on a project-based model, providing customized design and manufacturing solutions with short delivery cycles, especially for prototyping and small batch orders. It also earns income from material procurement services and financial investments related to cash management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the PCB design and PCBA manufacturing service sector in China, recognized for its large-scale design team and advanced technological capabilities. It competes with numerous small and medium-sized PCB and EMS providers but differentiates itself through high-quality, flexible manufacturing, rapid delivery, and deep integration with leading chip manufacturers and technology firms. Its strategic investments in PCB manufacturing further strengthen its competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 887.65 million, representing a 12.91% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 88.58 million, a 10.38% decrease year-over-year, impacted by new factory ramp-up costs. The company has total assets of about RMB 2.8 billion and equity of RMB 2.18 billion, with a stable growth trajectory supported by ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shenzhen Edadoc Technology offers a unique one-stop hardware innovation platform integrating PCB design, manufacturing, material procurement, and testing services. Its large, experienced design team and advanced simulation capabilities ensure high-quality, reliable PCB designs. The company’s flexible and rapid PCBA manufacturing services cater specifically to prototyping and small batch needs, reducing customers' development costs and time-to-market. Strong partnerships with leading chip manufacturers and a comprehensive supply chain enhance its ability to deliver customized, high-performance solutions.
